title: For each IPv4 subnet that has a positive average DNS nameserver order, show
question: For each IPv4 subnet that has a positive average DNS nameserver order, show the subnet name, tenant ID, network ID, IP version, CIDR, gateway IP, DHCP enabled flag, allocation pool first and last IP, the maximum subnet standard attribute ID over the current row and next 2 rows (ordered by subnet ID), the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of DNS nameserver order values for that subnet, and keep only those subnets whose coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) is greater than the average coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) across all such IPv4 subnets; order the results by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.network_id,
    s.ip_version,
    s.cidr,
    s.gateway_ip,
    s.enable_dhcp,
    s.standard_attr_id,
    STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN dnsnameservers d ON d.subnet_id = s.id
  WHERE s.ip_version = 4
  GROUP BY
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.network_id,
    s.ip_version,
    s.cidr,
    s.gateway_ip,
    s.enable_dhcp,
    s.standard_attr_id
  HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0
),
with_window AS (
  SELECT
    b.*,
    MAX(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (
      ORDER BY b.id
      ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING
    ) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2
  FROM base b
),
avg_cv AS (
  SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  w.name AS subnet_name,
  w.tenant_id,
  w.network_id,
  w.ip_version,
  w.cidr,
  w.gateway_ip,
  w.enable_dhcp AS dhcp_enabled,
  p.first_ip AS allocation_pool_first_ip,
  p.last_ip AS allocation_pool_last_ip,
  w.max_standard_attr_id_next2,
  w.coefficient_of_variation
FROM with_window w
JOIN ipallocationpools p ON p.subnet_id = w.id
CROSS JOIN avg_cv a
WHERE w.coefficient_of_variation > a.avg_coefficient_of_variation
ORDER BY w.coefficient_of_variation DESC
